rope: Jump rope. Small, quiet bounces on the balls of your feet, just a couple of centimetres off the ground. Keep your elbows close to your ribs and turn the rope with your wrists.
pushup: Push-ups. Body in one straight line from head to heels, squeeze your glutes. Elbows at about forty-five degrees, chest all the way down, then push the floor away.
pike: Pike push-ups. Hips high, like an upside-down V. Lower the top of your head toward a point just in front of your hands, then press back up.
ohp: One-arm overhead press. Stand tall and squeeze your glutes. Press straight up until your arm is by your ear, and don't lean away from the weight. Left arm, then right arm.
split: Split squats. Back foot on the floor. Lower your back knee straight down toward the ground, keep the front heel down, then stand back up. Left leg, then right leg.
hollow: Hollow body hold. Press your lower back flat into the floor. That's the whole exercise. Lift your shoulders and legs a little. If your back lifts, bend your knees.
sideplank: Side plank. Elbow right under your shoulder. Push your hips up so you make one straight line from head to feet. Breathe.
extrot: External rotation. Lie on your side, elbow pinned to your ribs. Rotate the weight up toward the ceiling, then lower it slowly for three seconds. Light and controlled.
ytw: Prone Y, T, W. Lie face down. Lift your arms into a Y, then a T, then a W, thumbs up. Squeeze your shoulder blades. Small lifts, no arching your lower back.
revcurl: Reverse wrist curls. Forearm on your thigh, palm down. Lift the back of your hand, then lower slowly. Go light on the right hand, and stop if your wrist goes above two out of ten.
bands: Finger extensor bands. Band around all five fingertips. Open your hand wide against the band, then close slowly.
hips: Hip mobility. Ease into each position and breathe. No bouncing, no forcing. Follow the pictures on the screen.
hip_frog: Frog stretch. On your forearms and knees. Spread your knees wide, shins out to the sides, then slowly push your hips back until you feel your inner thighs.
hip_ninety: Ninety ninety switches. Both knees bent at ninety degrees. Sit tall. Lift both knees and swing them over to the other side. Slow and controlled.
hip_couch: Couch stretch. Back shin up against the couch, front foot forward. Squeeze the glute of your back leg and keep your chest up. Feel the front of your hip.
hip_squat: Deep squat hold. Heels down, chest up. Sit as low as is comfortable and use your elbows to gently push your knees out.
hip_pancake: Pancake. Legs wide and straight, toes up. Sit tall, then walk your hands forward, folding from the hips with a long back.
scap: Scapular pull-ups. Hang with your arms completely straight. Pull your shoulder blades down and back so your body rises a few centimetres. Hold two seconds, then lower slowly.
pullup: Pull-ups. Start from a dead hang, arms fully straight. Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin is over it, then lower all the way down. Stop each set with a couple of reps left in the tank.
pulltest: Pull-up test. One all-out set. Dead hang at the bottom, chin over the bar at the top, full lockout every rep. Only clean reps count. Remember the number.
ringrow: Ring rows. Body straight like a plank. Pull the rings to your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades. Lower slowly for three seconds.
tuck: Tuck front lever. Arms locked straight. Pull your knees to your chest and push the bar down toward your hips until your back is level with the ground. Squeeze hard.
dips: Dip support hold. Arms locked out, shoulders pushed down away from your ears, body straight. Just hold.
ringpush: Ring push-ups. Keep the rings close to your body and stop them wobbling. Lower with control, and at the top, lock out and turn the rings slightly out.
knees: Hanging knee raises. Curl your pelvis up to bring your knees toward your chest. Pause at the bottom of every rep so you don't swing.
glides: Tendon glides. Straight hand, hook fist, full fist, tabletop, flat fist. Slowly, about two seconds in each position.
abra: Abrahangs. Your feet stay on the floor the whole time. Pull down gently, just two to four out of ten effort. Ten seconds on, then rest. The timer tells you which grip to use.
easyclimb: Easy problems. Eight to twelve problems, from V zero up to V three. Climb with silent feet. Then start your session.
facepull: Ring face pulls. Lean back, arms straight, palms down. Pull the rings toward your face with your elbows high and wide, then rotate your hands back beside your ears, like a goalpost. Lower slowly. Keep it light.
